list: The official 55 trophies as listed by PlayStation (via Exophase and PSNProfiles, agreeing on every name, description and grade), 1 platinum, 2 gold, 6 silver, 46 bronze, 28 hidden until earned, no online trophies. Guide text is this entry's own words; each trophy cites its sources.
sources_note: PowerPyx's GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Roadmap is the main source for roadmap, missables and 100% thresholds; KeenGamer, GameMapa, Mobalytics, games.gg and Insider Gaming cross-check the list. Five hidden trophies are still unsolved in the community guides and are marked unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned. There is nothing extra to do for it: work the roadmap in order — story, side missions, activities, collectibles, then the 100% checklist — and it unlocks by itself at the end.
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies in any order.
The platinum unlocks automatically once the last one pops.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy. Gone Fishing is the opening mission: play through it and the trophy pops at the end. If you are trophy hunting, use this first mission to learn the fishing controls — you will need them later for the fishing challenge against Cal.
steps: Play the opening mission Gone Fishing to its end.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 1. There is no mission replay in GTA VI, so keep a separate save at the start of each chapter — PowerPyx recommends one at the start and end of every chapter — in case you ever want to revisit a moment. Do the balcony meditation with Lucia in Chapter 1 before the chapter ends (see Positive Mental Attitude).
steps: Finish every Chapter 1 mission.
Keep a chapter-start save; do Lucia's balcony meditation before Chapter 1 ends.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 2. Play through the chapter's missions in order; the trophy pops when the chapter closes. Between story missions, use the downtime to try activities and scan vehicles — that progress already counts toward the 100% checklist.
steps: Finish every Chapter 2 mission.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 3. By now Vice City itself is fully open to you: roam it between missions to discover vehicles and areas, which feeds both Whip It Good and The Goodtime State.
steps: Finish every Chapter 3 mission.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Unmissable story trophy for finishing Chapter 4. One chapter remains after this: before the finale, check off any side-mission strands you have open, since quest givers can go quiet for stretches of the story (they all return in free-roam afterwards, per PowerPyx).
steps: Finish every Chapter 4 mission.
Clear open side missions before the finale where you can.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Gold for finishing the final story mission — the end of Chapter 5. After the credits, free-roam continues and everything needed for the 100% checklist stays accessible, so nothing in the endgame can lock you out of the platinum.
steps: Finish the final mission.
After the story, open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion to see what is left.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete Breakfast Run when it appears in the story. Like all mission trophies it is unmissable as long as you play the story through — the only way to lose it is to stop playing.
steps: Complete the Breakfast Run mission.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete The Cartel Heist. Heist missions are the big set-pieces — stock up on armour and ammo beforehand, and remember that failing and retrying a mission costs nothing but time.
steps: Complete The Cartel Heist mission.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete Child's Play. It pops at the end of the mission, so just play the story through.
steps: Complete the Child's Play mission.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete Headliners. Unmissable on a full playthrough.
steps: Complete the Headliners mission.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete VCIA Takedown at Vice City International Airport. This mission also teaches you the airport layout — useful later for Catch Me If You Can, the unscheduled departure.
steps: Complete the VCIA Takedown mission.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Story mission trophy: complete Operation Savage Glory. Unmissable on a full playthrough — the last of the named-mission story trophies before the finale.
steps: Complete the Operation Savage Glory mission.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Gold for 100% completion — the hardest trophy in the set, and the last one most players earn. The checklist only becomes viewable after the story, at Progress > Stats > 100% Completion, but progress made during the story already counts. PowerPyx stresses it is lenient: it is closer to 60% of true completion. You only need to scan 200 of 277 base-model vehicles, study 100 of 255 animals through binoculars, and finish 70 of 80 challenges, so skip the hardest challenges. Most side quests are not required and collectibles are only partly required.
steps: Finish the story first — the checklist unlocks afterwards.
Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion and work the list.
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals.
Finish any 70 of the 80 challenges — skip the hardest 10.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Silver for 250 stunts — jumps, near misses, drifts and air time all count, and the counter tracks unique stunt moments across Leonida. The fastest way is to chain them while travelling: hit jump ramps, thread traffic at speed, and drift corners. It builds naturally over a full playthrough, so check the counter in the Progress menu before grinding it at the end.
steps: Play normally — stunts accumulate as you drive.
Chain jumps, near misses and drifts while travelling between objectives.
Check the stunt counter in Progress before grinding the remainder.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try one of each of the nine activity types: fishing, races, the shooting range, Top Fun drone races, arcade games, bowling, meditation, hunting and the remaining activity the game lists under Activities. The in-game Activities menu shows which types you have tried, so use it as your checklist — one try each is enough, you do not need to win or finish them.
steps: Open the Activities menu to see the nine types.
Try one of each type — winning is not required.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Silver for gold medals in all 42 Shooting Range challenges. Ranges open as you discover them across Leonida; each challenge scores accuracy and speed, so take your time on the first shots and learn each range's target pattern before going for gold. The medals are not too difficult, per PowerPyx — steady aim beats rushing.
steps: Find a shooting range and try its challenges.
Learn each target pattern, then go for gold.
Gold all 42 challenges across every range.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at all 14 locations. Drone races are short time trials through rings — learn a course's line on a slow first run, then race it properly. Each location counts separately, so the in-game race menu is your checklist for which of the 14 you still need.
steps: Enter a Top Fun drone race at each location.
Learn the ring line first, then race for the win.
Win at all 14 locations.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — each race course counts once, so variety matters more than repeats. Races span street circuits, off-road tracks and water courses across Leonida; the race menu shows which you have won. Pick a fast, stable car for street races and a bike or off-roader where the course demands it.
steps: Open the race menu and pick an unwon race.
Win 20 different races — repeats do not count.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal, the fishing rival, in a fishing challenge. Fishing challenges score the weight and rarity of your catch in a time limit: use the best rod and bait you can buy, fish where the challenge marker points, and reel steadily — letting the line snap costs the round. Cal's challenge unlocks through the fishing activity as you progress.
steps: Take on Cal's fishing challenge.
Use good bait and gear, and keep the line from snapping.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game — any cabinet, any arcade. Walk up to a machine, play a full game to its end, and the trophy pops. Arcades are scattered around Vice City and the smaller towns; this is one of the quickest trophies in the set.
steps: Find an arcade cabinet.
Play one arcade game to completion.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's mission strand — his final mission pops this trophy. Side quest givers can go temporarily quiet during stretches of the story, but PowerPyx confirms every trophy-related character is available again in free-roam after the story, so if Andy is not answering, keep playing the story and come back.
steps: Follow Andy's missions to the final one.
If he is unavailable, advance the story and return later.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's mission strand. Kenton is one of the quest givers who can be temporarily unavailable mid-story — that is normal and does not lock the trophy. Play on, and his missions resume later; his final mission ends the strand and pops the trophy.
steps: Follow Kenton's missions to the final one.
If he is unavailable, advance the story and return later.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's mission strand — his final mission pops the trophy. Billy's strand is bike-flavoured, so keep a decent motorcycle handy for his jobs.
steps: Follow Billy's missions to the final one.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 8 stranger mission strands across Leonida. Strangers appear as question-mark icons on the map — talk to them, take their jobs, and follow each strand to its end. The five named side strands (Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone) are separate trophies; this one counts the other stranger strands, so roam the state and answer every question mark you find.
steps: Look for question-mark stranger icons across Leonida.
Complete 8 full stranger strands.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's mission strand — his final mission pops the trophy. Randy's jobs revolve around supply runs; keep a fast car with cargo space for his deliveries.
steps: Follow Randy's missions to the final one.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's mission strand — his final mission pops the trophy. Tyrone's strand is the last of the five named side strands; clearing all five plus the stranger strands is the backbone of the side-mission stage of the roadmap.
steps: Follow Tyrone's missions to the final one.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE ONE POSSIBLY MISSABLE TROPHY — do it first, in Chapter 1. There are 18 meditation spots across Leonida, and the first meditation is Lucia's on the balcony at Jason's house: after the Chapter 1 mission Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning — she says she is going to meditate — then follow her to the balcony and choose Accept. She shows you how to meditate, and the counter in the Progress menu goes up by 1. PowerPyx and GameMapa both report this meditation disappears after Chapter 1, and it is still unconfirmed whether it is required for the trophy — the safe move is to do it. After that, meditate at the other 17 marked spots; the remaining spots stay available in free-roam.
steps: In Chapter 1, after Down to Earth: talk to Lucia in the kitchen in the morning.
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — do this before Chapter 1 ends.
Then meditate at the other 17 meditation spots across Leonida.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal Bret asks for. Bret's hunting jobs point you at a specific rare animal — follow his marker, track it quietly, and take the shot cleanly. Hunting also feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 100 of 255 animals studied through binoculars, so study animals as you hunt.
steps: Take Bret's hunting job and follow the marker.
Track the unique animal and take it down.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Silver for completing 3 collectible card sets. Cards are hidden in shops, houses and landmarks across Leonida — check shelves, counters and display cases as you explore. A set completes when you hold every card in it; the collection menu shows which sets you have finished and which cards are still missing.
steps: Search shops, houses and landmarks for collectible cards.
Complete 3 full card sets.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Silver for using the in-game phone's WAiNK app at 100 locations. WAiNK It means taking a WAiNK photo at a spot — landmarks, viewpoints, beaches, city corners and roadside curiosities all count. Do it as you travel: whenever you pass somewhere photogenic, open WAiNK and snap it. The app tracks how many of the 100 you have done.
steps: Open the WAiNK app on the in-game phone at a location.
WAiNK It at 100 different locations.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Challenges are the game's mini-objectives — driving feats, combat feats, exploration feats and more — and they stack up over normal play. The 100% checklist wants 70 of the 80 challenges, so this trophy pops on the way there; pick the easy ones first and leave the hardest 10 alone entirely.
steps: Play normally and complete challenges as they come.
Finish any 50 — the checklist later wants 70 of 80.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star wanted level while your partner is with you, then escape. The easiest reported escape is the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County: police struggle to follow along the tracks and the helicopter loses sight of you, and the trophy unlocks once you leave the red heat zone. Robbing a bank vault instantly gives you a 4-star wanted level, so this often pops by itself during Maximum Withdrawal.
steps: Get a 4-star wanted level with your partner beside you.
Escape — the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County works well.
The trophy pops once you leave the red heat zone.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your wanted level — the trick is keeping the wanted level, not losing it: do not let the heat drop between robberies, and do not get busted or wasted. The three jewelry stores in the north of Vice City work well, per GameMapa, since they are close together. Go in fast, grab the goods, and move straight to the next shop.
steps: With your partner, rob a shop and keep your wanted level.
Rob two more shops back-to-back without losing the heat.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles — getting into a new vehicle model for the first time counts as discovering it. The 100% checklist wants 200 of 277 base-model vehicles scanned, so this pops on the way there. Drive everything you see: cars, bikes, boats, planes and trucks all count.
steps: Drive a vehicle model you have never driven before.
Discover 100 different vehicles.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies during a single use of Combat Focus (the slow-mo aiming mode). Before the fight, buff your focus with food, drinks or a shower at home, and bring Adrenaline; an assault rifle works well, per GameMapa. Pick a fight with a group of at least five enemies, trigger Combat Focus, and drop all five before it runs out.
steps: Buff focus with food, drinks or a shower; carry Adrenaline.
Find a group of 5+ enemies and trigger Combat Focus.
Take down 5 enemies before it ends.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure from Vice City International Airport: get to a plane on the tarmac and take off without going through a scheduled departure. The airport is guarded, so go in fast — steal a plane and get airborne before security closes in. The VCIA Takedown mission teaches you the airport layout first.
steps: Get to VCIA and reach a plane on the tarmac.
Take off without a scheduled departure.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with the Rhino tanks. Rhinos roll in at high wanted levels and during military responses — survive the encounter and take one on: sticky bombs and heavy weapons do the job, and cover is essential since a Rhino's cannon ends a fight fast. Community reports put this down to engaging a Rhino rather than any one scripted moment.
steps: Reach a high wanted level or a military response until a Rhino appears.
Take it on with heavy weapons and cover.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected — no alarms, no witnesses, no wanted level. Go at night, move quietly, smash the cases fast and leave before anyone reacts. If a clerk or guard spots you, the attempt fails: leave, let the heat die, and try another store.
steps: Pick a jewelry store and go at night.
Smash the cases and leave before anyone reacts — no detection.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Silver for robbing 5 bank vaults and escaping each time. Bank vaults are the big robberies: plan an escape route before you go in, and expect a 4-star wanted level the moment the vault opens — which also feeds Hot Together. Five clean getaways, and the silver is yours.
steps: Rob a bank vault.
Escape the police afterwards.
Repeat for 5 vaults.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and escape. Armored trucks patrol the roads of Leonida — ram one to a stop or block it, crack it open, take the cash and lose the wanted level. It is the classic GTA robbery, and the 100% checklist asks for more than this, so it comes naturally on a completionist run.
steps: Find an armored truck on the road.
Stop it, rob it, and escape.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all 52 areas of Leonida — every named district, town and stretch of wilderness on the map. The map shades in areas you have visited, so fly or drive the edges: the swamps, the Keys, the farmland and the small towns are the ones players miss. A full map sweep in a plane is the fastest way to finish the last few areas.
steps: Visit every named area of the map.
Check the map for unvisited shading; sweep the edges by plane.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs. Illegal operations are gang-run fronts — stash houses, chop shops, deal spots — marked when you scout them. Hit one per gang; the map and your contacts point you at each gang's territory, so work through them gang by gang.
steps: Scout an illegal operation run by a gang.
Rob one operation for each of the 9 gangs.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method yet. The description itself is the hint: enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. The likely method is ordering a drink at a beachfront bar on Ocean Drive and watching the view — but the exact spot is still being confirmed by the community, so check PowerPyx's guide for updates before hunting it.
steps: Head to a beachfront bar on Ocean Beach.
Order a cocktail and take in the view — exact spot still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method yet. The description is the hint: smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. The likely method is driving a car straight through a showroom's glass front — but the exact showroom is still being confirmed by the community, so check PowerPyx's guide for updates.
steps: Find a vehicle showroom.
Drive out through its glass front — exact showroom still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley: play a full game of bowling there and finish it properly — the follow-through is the point, so complete the game rather than walking out mid-frame. The alley is in Vice City; bowling also counts toward trying the activity types for Master of None.
steps: Go to the Kolt & Associates bowling alley.
Play a full game of bowling to the end.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: A partnership moment with mass appeal — most likely a WAiNK post with your partner that goes big. The community reads this as a social-media moment: post with your partner from a striking spot and watch the reaction. Treat the exact trigger as unconfirmed and check PowerPyx's guide for updates.
steps: Do something worth posting with your partner.
Share the moment — exact trigger still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — dialogue picks, action decisions, the small calls the story offers you. PlayStation tracks a count toward 500, per the trophy list data, so this pops naturally over a full playthrough as you keep choosing. There is nothing to grind: just keep deciding.
steps: Keep making story and dialogue choices as you play.
The counter climbs toward 500 over a full playthrough.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method yet. The name and description point at succeeding on a second attempt at something that failed the first time. The community is still pinning down which attempt counts, so check PowerPyx's guide for updates rather than chasing a guess.
steps: Fail an attempt at something, then succeed on the second try — exact trigger still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method yet. The description suggests witnessing something strange — Leonida's oddities, the kind of event that makes you stop and stare. The community is still confirming which sighting triggers it, so check PowerPyx's guide for updates.
steps: Keep an eye out for Leonida's strange sights — exact trigger still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: UNCONFIRMED — PowerPyx lists this as one of five hidden trophies with no confirmed method yet. The description is the hint: knock someone over with a melee attack from a moving vehicle — a melee drive-by. The exact conditions are still being confirmed by the community, so check PowerPyx's guide for updates before hunting it.
steps: From a moving vehicle, knock someone down with a melee attack — exact conditions still unconfirmed.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come from robberies and heists; your contacts wash them into clean cash for a cut. Keep laundering after every big score — the total climbs steadily, and the 100% checklist and Treat Yo Self both benefit from the same money flow.
steps: Collect Marked Bills from robberies and heists.
Launder them through your contacts until $250,000 is clean.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — clothes, weapons, car mods, food, anything with a price tag. It counts cumulatively across the whole playthrough, so it usually pops on its own once you start buying gear and property. If you are close at the end, car modifications are the fastest way to burn the remainder.
steps: Spend money in shops as you play.
Top up with car mods if you are short at the end.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. Garages are bought through the in-game property listings as they unlock across Leonida — each one stores vehicles and counts toward the total. They are not cheap, so save the purchases for after the big heist payouts.
steps: Check property listings for garages as they unlock.
Buy all 8 garage properties.

sources.name: KeenGamer — GTA 6 Trophy Guide & Platinum Roadmap

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. Scooter Bros is the in-game vehicle delivery app — register vehicles you own or find to it, and each registration counts. Ten registrations is quick once you know the app: drive a vehicle, open the app, register it, repeat.
steps: Open the Scooter Bros app with a vehicle.
Register 10 different vehicles.
